pre_mortem: It is Monday and Flowers stayed below 59 because Baltimore's rushing matchup mattered more than its receiving opportunity: Henry controlled the game against a defense allowing 4.64 yards per carry, and Flowers never received enough volume. Alternatively, his targets came against Cleveland's more efficient outside pass defense rather than its weaker middle, or an unreported quarterback or health limitation reduced production. The pack lacks alignment and game-by-game distributions to reject those cases. That keeps this a script-dependent lean, not a strong play.
